title: Review stream: API contract and the four platform suites
description:
**Review stream for Peter — one review, one test pass, 19 tickets.**

## The one test pass

1. Regenerate the OpenAPI spec, then **restart** the api-gateway container. The yaml is bind-mounted, so a restart publishes it and a rebuild does not.
2. `cd systemTest/schemathesis && python3 scripts/run.py pre-merge --base-url http://localhost:6882` — **13.4 min measured** (~2,016 cases over 318 operations). Report **the failing SET of operation ids and its diff against the develop baseline set**, never a bare count.
3. `node scripts/preflight/spec-auth-conformance.mjs --base http://localhost:6882` (seconds) — every bearer-authed operation must reject unauthenticated.
4. `cd systemTest/playwright && npm run quality:static && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e` — **3.8 s measured**, all three must pass.
5. `cd systemTest/performance && npm run test:smoke` — **53 s measured**. Read **the printed** `Status:` **line, not the exit code**, which is 0 either way.

## Two traps that make this run lie

* **A second back-to-back Schemathesis run fails at *setup* with 401**, not on a finding: the fuzz tiers change the test persona's password. `docker restart secuura-auth` re-seeds it. The `Run validity: OK` line does not catch this — it counts schemathesis operations, not pytest setup errors.
* **A partial stack produces a confident FALSE RED. **`docker-compose.local.yml` defines 38 services; when some are down the gateway answers `502 BAD_GATEWAY` and the suites score it as a defect indistinguishable from a real one. Run `docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml ps` first and confirm every service is up.

Commands and wall-clocks are quoted from `Blockchain/Dev/docs/DEV-PROCESS.md` section *Manual CI-gate equivalents*.

nodes.body:
**Superseded figure, for the record.** This ticket's description quotes the k6 smoke wall-clock as "`npm run test:smoke` — **53 s measured**" (from `Blockchain/Dev/docs/DEV-PROCESS.md`, undated, no host).

Re-measured under KS-1354 on 2026-09-28: **43–44 s** runner wall-clock (including actor provisioning), Apple M2 Max, slot 1, on both k6 2.1.0 and 2.3.0, and 42 s again on a later 2.3.0 run. Four stacks were up, so the runs are `machineShared: true` — not a baseline. KS-1354 updates `DEV-PROCESS.md` and the QA cheat sheet to that figure with the caveat. No action needed here; noting it so the 53 s is not re-quoted.

## RECORD ONLY — Kam's ruling on the #800 status question. No new ask, nothing for Peter to action here.

### `secuura-800-peter-nudge-2026-09-03` — Kam, recorded 2026-09-04 08:38
**Verbatim: `doconly` = "Facts-only status doc, no nudge (DEFAULT)".**

**What that rules out, stated plainly:** there is to be **no chase, reminder or nudge** to @PeterObeden about review throughput. The deliverable was a facts-only status document and nothing else.

**Where it stands.** The document exists as **PR #811** — *"docs: PR status for Peter, measured 2026-09-04 04:46Z — written, NOT sent"* — still **OPEN**, and its own title records that it was deliberately not sent. The measured answer it carries was posted as a comment on **KS-485**, and this ticket plus KS-771 and KS-772 each carry a pointer to it (`90cbe598` here, 2026-09-05T04:01Z), correctly framed as "Pointer, not a new ask".

So the ruling is **satisfied in substance** — facts were published, no nudge was sent — and this comment supplies the missing piece: the ruling itself, recorded on the review-stream parent, so the "no nudge" half is discoverable by whoever next wonders why nobody chased the queue.

**Provenance:** Wednesday's s137 successor brief, 2026-09-05T21:53:00Z (SPF + DKIM + DMARC pass), item 0(b), card 11. Client-facing communication stays on tickets; the extranet is input-only.

**Pointer, not a new ask:** the current PR-status answer (which PRs are live on develop, which are open and at what review state, measured `2026-09-05T04:00:52Z`) is posted as a comment on **KS-485**, so there is one place for it rather than four. Nothing needed on this ticket.

**Reviewer: Peter.** Nineteen tickets, one review, one test pass — the four platform suites run once against a freshly published spec.

Folded in: *Schemathesis API Contract Testing* (11) · *OpenAPI Spec & Contract* (6) · *Playwright UI & Journey Testing* (1) · *Performance & Load Testing k6* (1). The full pass, both traps and the measured wall-clocks are in the description.

The two things most likely to waste your afternoon: a **second** back-to-back Schemathesis run fails at *setup* with 401 (the fuzz tiers change the persona's password — `docker restart secuura-auth` re-seeds), and a **partial stack** returns 502s that score as findings. Check `docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml ps` before you start.
